dedupe_keys.name: optimizing the geometric configuration and manufacturing process of high mast illumination poles

description: University of Texas at San Antonio researchers publish an Excel workbook supporting a study of residual stresses in high-mast illumination poles. The October 2020 Zenodo deposit is freely downloadable under CC BY 4.0 and is independently identified by the US National Transportation Library. The study uses a Texas Department of Transportation pole-to-base-plate connection and sequential thermal and mechanical analyses in Abaqus Welding Interface, followed by hot-dip galvanising calculations. Welding temperature, dipping speed and inclination are varied to investigate cracking-prone regions. The workbook can support comparison or calibration of manufacturing-stress simulations for roadside structures. No related catalogue record explicitly covers it. The public file inventory contains study data, not an executable Abaqus model. Sheet variables, units, mesh resolution, sample counts and uncertainty were not independently checked. Modelled manufacturing conditions do not establish field crack rates or service-life performance. The workbook was not downloaded.
